mode.title: What to get
mode.description: offers = every single offer (cloud × GPU × price × stock). gpus = one row per GPU model with its cheapest price. providers = the clouds tracked. index = the GPU Price Index (median across clouds).

gpu.title: GPU
gpu.description: GPU model, loose match: h100 matches every H100 variant. Examples: h100, h200-sxm, b200, b300, a100, rtx-5090, rtx-4090, l40s, mi300x. Comma-separate several. Empty = all.

region.title: Region
region.description: Where it must be in stock: an area (Europe, US, Asia), a country code (DE, US), a data-center id or a city (Frankfurt). Offers only.

maxPrice.title: Max price ($ per GPU-hour)
maxPrice.description: Only offers at or below this price. Offers only.

cloudType.title: Cloud type
cloudType.description: datacenter = the cloud's own machines. community = marketplace hosts (Vast.ai, Clore, ...), often cheaper.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: on_demand runs until you stop it; spot is cheaper but can be stopped by the cloud.

inStock.title: Availability
inStock.description: true = only what you can rent right now. false = only sold-out offers. any = both.

provider.title: Cloud
provider.description: One cloud by id or name, e.g. runpod, lambda, vast. Comma-separate several. Offers only.

excludeResellers.title: Exclude resellers
excludeResellers.description: Leave out clouds that resell other clouds' GPUs.

history.title: Index history
history.description: Index mode only: none = current value; hourly or daily = one row per point.
